component.name: SplitKeyboard
component.summary: A split-layout on-screen keyboard for X11 (wide displays / Steam Deck)

description.p: SplitKeyboard is an X11 on-screen keyboard, a fork of CoreKeyboard, with the keys packed into the left and right quarters of the screen and a see-through, click-through middle. It's built for two-thumb typing on wide displays such as the Steam Deck, and supports multitouch and hybrid (armed / momentary) modifiers.

It requires an X11 session (for example the Steam Deck's desktop mode). On Wayland it runs through XWayland but cannot inject keystrokes into native Wayland windows, so it is not intended for Wayland desktops.

ul.li: Fixed the Super+K hotkey not working after a reboot: when launched at login (Start on login), the app could start before KDE's global-shortcut service was ready and miss the registration. It now waits for the service and registers as soon as it appears.

The Super+K toggle hotkey now works under a Wayland session: on KDE it registers with KGlobalAccel, so it fires even when a native Wayland window has focus (previously it could fall through and type a bare "k"). It falls back to an X11 grab off KDE.
The empty middle is now genuinely click-through under rootless Xwayland/KWin (the window's input region follows the visible cut-out).
New optional "Start on login" toggle in the tray menu. When enabled, SplitKeyboard launches automatically at login, minimized to the tray (show it with the Super+K hotkey or the tray icon).
The keyboard now re-anchors its position and size each time it is shown, so it lands correctly even when started hidden.
The bottom KDE panel now un-floats while the keyboard is shown, so it sits flush against the keyboard instead of overlapping the bottom key row; it re-floats when the keyboard is hidden.
Sharper key labels and icons under HiDPI / fractional display scaling.
Fixed the floating window's placement on first show.

description.p: First release of SplitKeyboard, a split-layout fork of CoreKeyboard for wide displays and the Steam Deck.
